name: Debashish Deb
title: Biotechnologist Turned Developer • Research Lab IT & Full-Stack
tagline: Biotechnologist turned software developer. Managing IT systems, research databases, and supercomputing workflows at Färkkilä Lab (University of Helsinki). Learning continuously as an intermediate developer, building practical software with Go, React, TypeScript, and Flutter, and open to select freelance projects.
about: I am a molecular biotechnologist who fell in love with software development. Based in Finland, I handle IT and systems responsibilities at Färkkilä Laboratory (Biomedicum Helsinki, University of Helsinki). As an intermediate-level developer, I focus on practical problem-solving, clean code, and continuous learning with Go, React, TypeScript, and Flutter, and I'm open to freelance work.
aboutExtended:
My journey began in molecular biotechnology, earning an M.Sc. at the University of Helsinki and co-authoring cancer research papers in Haematologica and Blood. Working directly with complex laboratory screening data opened my eyes to the incredible power of software engineering.

Today, I work at Färkkilä Laboratory (Biomedicum Helsinki) managing IT infrastructure, research databases, and scientific computing workflows on Finnish CSC supercomputers for precision oncology studies (ONCOSYS-OVA).

I approach software engineering with humility and a growth mindset—I think like an intermediate developer: focusing on fundamental computer science principles at Kood/Sisu, writing maintainable code in Go, React/TypeScript, and Flutter, and applying the zero-defect quality discipline I developed in Finnish high-tech manufacturing (ABB and Swappie). I am also open to select freelance work for teams needing reliable web apps, mobile tools, or research data automation.
